احتفلتا (form VIII)
# اِحْتَفَلَتَا (iḥtafalatā) /iħ.ta.fa.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past active of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
# اُحْتُفِلَتَا (uḥtufilatā) /uħ.tu.fi.la.taː/: third-person feminine dual past passive of اِحْتَفَلَ (iḥtafala)
